item.title: Agents+
item.creator: DogHouse
item.description: Become the ultimate agent with futuristic tools, support drones, laser traps, mech suits, spy vehicles, and high-tech furniture! Fight new enemies, tame a cyber cat, mine with thermal vision goggles, and explore with quantum gear, hooks, hoverbikes, and more!

howToEntries.heading: Start with the Guide Book
howToEntries.content: When you enter a world for the first time, you receive the Agents+ Guide Book. Use it to browseGadgets & Tools, Robot Friends, Decorations, Advanced Machines, and hostile Mobs. It explains thecontrols and purpose of each feature.

howToEntries.heading: Collect Mech Scrap
howToEntries.content: Defeat Crawler, Mechanical Spider, Volter Serpent, and Memetic Orb enemies to collect Mech Scrap. Thisis the main crafting material used for Agents+ gadgets, drones, vehicles, furniture, and machines.

howToEntries.heading: Craft and Master Agent Gear
howToEntries.content: Use Mech Scrap with vanilla materials to craft powerful equipment. The Quantum Pickaxe clears a3x3x3 area of natural stone and ores, the Quantum Axe fells natural trees, and the Quantum Drill canbe toggled for rapid mining. Hold the Quantum Jetpack and Sneak while airborne to fly.

howToEntries.heading: Use the Hook, Blaster and Shield
howToEntries.content: Use the Blaster to fire energy bolts. Use the Hook once to fire it at a block, then use it again after itattaches to pull yourself toward the target. Use an Energy Shield to deploy a personal barrier thatabsorbs incoming damage until its charge is depleted.

howToEntries.heading: Deploy Drones and Vehicles
howToEntries.content: Place Medic, Cargo, and Echo Drones to link them to you automatically. Medic Drones heal you, CargoDrones provide storage, and Echo Drones attack nearby hostile mobs. Ride the Spy Car, Hoverbike, orMech Suit for fast travel and combat.

howToEntries.heading: Build and Secure Your HQ
howToEntries.content: Place furniture, lights, storage, terminals, and security devices to create an agent base. Placing a Locker,Safe, or Secure Chest gives you a Security Card if you do not already have one; hold the card and Usethe container to unlock it. Sneak + Use placed Agents+ furniture, drones, or machines to pick them backup.
